Agent = custom single-shot harness (no execution, temperature 0, max_tokens 8000, <= 2 apply retries) with Claude Sonnet 4.6 (alias claude-sonnet-4-6) for all resolve arms. Criterion: SWE-bench resolution; cost = mean context tokens and tokens per resolve (Table 3); whole registered run about $20 API for ~210 calls. Single run, N = 70. Each arm judged on its own absolute values (all are oracle ceilings).
- oracle_full + single-shot harness + Claude Sonnet 4.6: 19/70 = 0.271 [0.18, 0.39]; 25,426 mean tokens; 93,700 tokens/resolve. Quality partly; cost partly
- oracle_tier + harness + Sonnet 4.6: 23/70 = 0.329 [0.23, 0.44]; 8,629; 26,300. Quality partly; cost works
- oracle_keep_drop + harness + Sonnet 4.6: 25/70 = 0.357 [0.26, 0.47]; 6,876; 19,300 (re-run: 23/70). Quality partly; cost works
- keep/drop + sequence slice (follow-up, pre-registered H3) + harness + Sonnet 4.6: 26/70 = 0.371 [0.27, 0.49] vs keep/drop re-run 23/70; slice mean 215 extra tokens (present on 65/70). Quality partly; cost works
Probe study (answerer Claude Sonnet 4.6, no agent; n = 45; Table 2): full source 0.600 (27/45), 1,124 tokens: quality partly, cost works; summary by Sonnet 4.6 0.089 (4/45), 165 tokens: quality does not work, cost works; summary by Qwen2.5-Coder-3B 0.089 (4/45), 180 tokens: quality does not work, cost works; signature + docstring 0.133 (6/45), 212 tokens: quality does not work, cost works
fields.why: Round 1 gave oracle_full a double quality verdict ('partly / does not work') and a cost 'does not work' that reads as relative to the compressed arms; on its own 25K context tokens per single-shot call (about $0.10 per call, App. B) is not prohibitive, so partly (judgement). Probe arms lacked cost verdicts

fields.v: Tasks: all 70 valid multi-file SWE-bench Verified instances (whole pool, no sampling). Configurations: 3 representation arms (+ slice follow-up). Baseline: oracle_full (registered comparison: tier vs keep/drop). Held constant: oracle localization (same gold files), model, prompt (byte-identical except context), temperature, retry rules, harness; every gold edit verified expressible in every arm. Acceptance tests: SWE-bench FAIL_TO_PASS and PASS_TO_PASS; gold patch validated per instance. Repetitions: 1 (keep/drop re-run once). Human intervention: none. Protocol and hypotheses pre-registered and committed before data. Probe study: 15 held-out classes x 3 test-minted probes, same answerer, independent judge

H2 (tier > keep/drop) null: 23/70 vs 25/70, McNemar 4 vs 6, p = 0.754. Tier vs full p = 0.344; keep/drop vs full 25 vs 19, p = 0.070 (not claimed). Compressed arms match whole files at 3-3.7x fewer tokens; tokens per resolve 19,300 (keep/drop) vs 26,300 (tier) vs 93,700 (full). H3 slice vs keep/drop 26 vs 23, p = 0.375 (n.s.). Probes: source 27/45 vs summaries 4/45 (McNemar 23-vs-0, p < 1e-4); frontier and 3B summarizers identical. Run-to-run noise: 6/70 flips (~9%) between identical runs, larger than the H2 gap

Did not distinguish the representation arms on resolve (all within run-to-run noise); did distinguish on tokens and in the probe study. Repeatability: keep/drop re-run showed ~9% outcome flips at T = 0; probes single draws. Limitations stated: single-shot no-execution regime; oracle ceilings with asymmetric construction (compressed arms encode gold edit locations); probe scope 15 classes, one language; residual format penalty for tier; token proxy; one model family, Python

Single-shot, no-execution regime (multi-turn agents could recover by reading more); oracle localization, not deployable; compressed vs full confounds compression with location hinting; probes 15 classes, Python only; one model family; interaction-level artifacts and distance-graded detail specified but not implemented. Future: 2-step agent loop on the solvable subset (registered), act-view re-grade, in-the-loop version

Code, frozen instance lists, pre-registrations, per-instance harness reports public (MIT): github.com/integrallis/act-context. Pre-registration claimed (committed in the repository before data; link to repo given). Language: Python. Model alias only (no dated snapshot). Inconsistency: probe study stated as temperature 0 throughout (§4, Table 2 'strict T=0', App. C 'corrected strict T=0 rerun'), but the threats section says 'probe cells are single draws at T=1' (p. 7); values taken from Table 2. Exploratory results on author's own code quarantined in Appendix D (not claims). Figures 1-4 text garbled by pdftotext; values taken from Tables 2-4. Relevance to SDD: indirect (what context an agent needs, no specification approach)
